Veterans Benefits: Rhode Island fully exempts military retirement pay from state income tax, provides local property-tax exemptions for veterans and 100% disabled veterans, offers state park access and free hunting/fishing licenses for eligible disabled veterans, and provides veterans employment preference and education assistance.

Description: Historic coastal New England city on Aquidneck Island, anchored by Naval Station Newport, NUWC Division Newport, and rich maritime heritage. Offers scenic cliff walks, historic mansions, sailing, vibrant downtown waterfront, and strong veteran community support with an in-city VA outpatient clinic.
